# onlineornot_project (Resource)

Manages an organisation project. Only empty non-Default projects can be deleted. Requires project management permissions; these do not grant resource or secret permissions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "onlineornot_project" "staging" {
  name = "staging"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Editable display label, not a unique identifier. Use the encoded ID for selection.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Stable Default identity, independent of name.
- `updated_at` (String)
